mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of engineered quartz countertops over natural stone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineered quartz countertops offer several advantages over natural stone, particularly regarding maintenance and consistency. Quartz is non-porous, meaning it resists stains and doesn't require sealing, unlike many natural stones such as granite or marble. It also provides a more uniform appearance with a consistent color and pattern, as it's manufactured. While natural stone offers unique, one-of-a-kind patterns, quartz often provides greater durability against chipping and scratching. The choice between them often comes down to personal preference for natural variation versus consistent performance. Frasheski Construction can help you weigh these practical tradeoffs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineered quartz is non-porous, stain-resistant, and requires no sealing, unlike natural stone. It offers consistent appearance and high durability against chips and scratches.
